subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should iOS permanently retire the standalone Talk destination and make existing `talk` and `voice` launch aliases open the unified Chat surface?
rationale: The implementation is a deliberate user-facing navigation and upgrade change, not a mechanical repair; source and tests can show the behavior but cannot decide whether that new product contract is desired.

options.title: Approve unified Chat navigation
options.body: Accept Talk retirement and alias redirection, then require a clean rebase and exact-head device validation before merge.

options.title: Keep a dedicated Talk destination
options.body: Retain or restore the Talk tab and aliases if maintainers want realtime voice to remain a separately discoverable mode.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Land only the ownership and Live Activity hardening while deferring navigation consolidation to a separately approved iOS product decision.

recommendation.title: Approve unified Chat navigation
recommendation.body: Accept Talk retirement and alias redirection, then require a clean rebase and exact-head device validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline explicitly routes the prior navigation-contract decision to steipete, making this the strongest available review-routing signal.
